---
applyTo: "specs/**,src/**,tests/**,docs/**"
---

# SDD Instructions

- Read `AGENTS.md` first.
- Locate the controlling spec before changing code.
- Add or update acceptance criteria before implementing new behavior.
- Do not implement from placeholder-only specs.
- Keep implementation, tests, and documentation traceable to specs.
- Run `tools/sdd/validate-specs.ps1`, `tools/sdd/check-traceability.ps1`, and `tools/sdd/verify-build-spec.ps1` before review.
